root_cause.text: The `caif_free_client()` function releases the service layer object referenced by `adap_layer->dn` without clearing that pointer, so a subsequent call to `caif_free_client()` (e.g., from socket destructor) dereferences the freed memory, causing a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `layer_set_dn(adap_layer, NULL); layer_set_up(serv_layer, NULL);` before `servl->release(&servl->layer);`, explicitly preventing reuse of the stale pointers. The CVE description notes that `caif_free_client()` leaves the pointer stale, leading to the vulnerability.
